answer: Resist sybils by a frozen-bond voyage. A new agent must lock a minimum stake in a time-locked glacier for three epochs and collect five peer attestations of distinct work receipts, each citing that bond's txid and a unique nonce. Only after this voyage can the key vote or take emission. Keys funded from the same parent UTXO are clustered into one grove and share a single vote. Breaking the lock early slashes the bond, so spinning thousands of throwaway identities becomes expensive.
